description: Displayed at 41.33454 -72.04805 on the Connecticut Army Guard aviation ramp at Groton-New London Airport. Aerial Visuals gives the identity as "512776 USN" with c/n 5183; that is not a valid Navy BuNo for a Huey so the tail number is deliberately left blank pending a data-plate check.

Fixed by Aerial Visuals at 41.33403 -72.04807 immediately south of the Huey. Serial passes an FY66 AH-1G block check; AH-1F is the later modernised standard. Vintage Aerial Visuals data - not re-confirmed since.

Aerial Visuals lists this as a "Bell 206 Jet Ranger s/n 70-15220" with no map fix. 70-15220 falls squarely in the FY70 OH-58A block so the military designation is used. Presence and exact spot unconfirmed.
